# CartWise

> CartWise is a free website that helps US shoppers fight grocery inflation using only real, sourced, dated public data. It never shows sample or invented prices. If a number can't be verified, it's left out.

## Tools and data sources
- Everyday groceries: enter a ZIP and a shopping list. Matched items are priced at U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Average Price Data (U.S. city average, monthly) and shown with the year-over-year change. Source: https://www.bls.gov/cpi/factsheets/average-prices.htm
- Gas: a ZIP code maps to its state, which shows AAA's state average prices for regular, mid-grade, premium, and diesel, plus the state's national rank. Source: https://gasprices.aaa.com/state-gas-price-averages/
- Restaurant cost estimator: party presets (couple date night, family of 4, custom) with drinks, appetizer, and dessert options, plus sales tax and tip (tip on the pre-tax subtotal). Uses median real menu prices from Denny's online menu for one listed store, labeled as an estimate. Source: https://www.dennys.com/menu
- Organic groceries: organic tips (EWG Dirty Dozen vs. Clean Fifteen, frozen organic, store-brand organic). Organic store prices are shown only when verified. None are currently published.
- Tips: unit-price traps, meat and bakery markdown timing, international and bulk aisle swaps, price matching and rain checks, store-brand equivalents, shrinkflation, coupon and cash-back stacking.

## Facts
- Free, no account. Hosted as a static site.
- Each data file in /data has a "retrieved" date and a source URL.
- Not affiliated with BLS, AAA, Kroger, Walmart, or any restaurant chain.
